messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected across /v1/generate routes. Error spike started ~10:34 UTC, auto-pager triggered. Paging oncall @jamie :rotating_light:
jamie (oncall): looking. signal shows 5xx and gateway timeouts, not client errors. Any obvious rollout?
arjun (runtime): no deploys in last hour. I'm seeing batching backlog building on scheduler nodes — queue depth on batcher-shard-3 jumped, head-of-line latency increasing.
sophie (sre): seeing customer-facing timeouts in dashboard — spike correlates with embed and generate flows concurrently. Some routes are 504 gateway from API proxy.
jamie (oncall): small triage: 1) confirm ingress throttles 2) check batcher backlog 3) start mitigation (evictions/reroute)
darcy (eng): I'm on batcher logs. KV cache prefetch on shard-3 started stalling, inflight batches piling up. There's a small set of long requests monopolizing the batch window -> head-of-line.
arjun (runtime): reproducer: long-running request pattern with seq_len=4096, no streaming, high token generation. Continuous batching keeps waiting to fill windows. Batching scheduler is saturating.
sophie (sre): customer impact: ~12% of requests returning 5xx/gateway within affected region (us-west). A few paying customers seeing slowdowns; support getting tickets.
mike (support): flagged two customers on high tier—support: please notify if we fallback models.
jamie (oncall): mitigation plan: A) enable short-term ingress throttle for large token requests B) evict stuck batches older than 3s C) route new small-request traffic to fallback lighter model D) scale up batcher pool as emergency.
darcy (eng): implementing eviction now. Patch: set old_batch_eviction_ms=3000 on shard-3.
arjun (runtime): evict policy applied to shard-3. Running quick sanity: 
```
# check queue depth
kubectl exec -it batcher-shard-3 -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s localhost:8080/metrics | grep batch_queue_depth"
```
queue depth dropped ~40% within 30s.
sophie (sre): good. I'll flip ingress throttle for seq_len>2048 to 2rps across edge LB. Command in proxy: 
```
proxyctl set-rate-limit --route "/v1/generate" --filter "meta.seq_len>2048" --rps 2
```
jamie (oncall): done, rate-limit pushed. Monitoring errors.
arjun (runtime): also pushed a temporary route rule to send small payloads to redwood-small-v1 to reduce scheduler pressure: 
```
routerctl add-rule --match "tokens<=512" --route redwood-small-v1
```
ops-bot: routing change applied by arjun.
mike (support): pinging customers A and B: told them we are mitigating and will follow up. They acknowledged.
sophie (sre): metrics: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 4% in 2m. Gateway timeouts trending down. Head-of-line latencies halved on shard-3.
darcy (eng): scaling: spinning up 2 more batcher pods to absorb backlog: 
```
kubectl scale deployment batcher-shard-3 --replicas=5
```
jamie (oncall): good. Keep throttles in place until we have stable queue depth for 15m. Also plan postmortem. Assigning ownership to @darcy for runtime fix, @sophie for oncall runbook updates, @arjun for routing rules rollback plan.
arjun (runtime): noted. I'll prepare canary rollback steps to revert routing after traffic stabilizes.
sophie (sre): we'll keep support loop updated. mike, please collect the affected request IDs for customers.
mike (support): collecting request ids now, adding to ticket.
jamie (oncall): quick status at +10m: backlog normalized, errors ~2.1%, no new pages. Holding page open for 30m observation.
darcy (eng): root cause initial hypothesis: long-lived high-token requests prevented batches from moving and blocked shorter requests in the same queue (head-of-line). Need smarter preemption or separate priority queues for long-gen.
arjun (runtime): agree. I'll prototype per-request priority + early-evict for long token windows and a knob to keep small requests fast.
sophie (sre): action items created: 1) emergency mitigation checklist in runbook 2) add metric alert on batch_queue_depth per-shard 3) add routing rule tests 4) notify customers with post-incident summary.
jamie (oncall): handing off to darcy for deeper fix and postmortem writeup. I'll stay available for questions. Closing pager for oncall. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident transitioned to 'investigating -> mitigated', severity lowered.
darcy (eng): will run longer-term patch: split queues by expected token-length, add preemptive eviction at 1.5s for pending small requests. ETA for patch: 3 days, will schedule canary.
sophie (sre): scheduling postmortem meeting at 16:00 UTC to capture timeline and customer comms.
mike (support): creating external status note draft. Will share in #customer-commms for review.
jamie (oncall): summary for thread: cause: batching head-of-line blocking from long token requests -> scheduler saturation -> gateway timeouts. Mitigations: ingress throttle for large seq_len, eviction policy, route small payloads to smaller model, scale batcher pods. Customer impact: limited but notable for some high-tier customers; support engaged. Next: implement queue-splitting & preemption.
sophie (sre): closing thread after observation window unless new regressions. Thanks team. :pray:
